paper.title_en: Fermionic Spectral Functions in a Two-Current Gubser-Rocha Model with Axion Momentum Relaxation
paper.abstract_en: We investigate fermionic spectral functions in a two-current Gubser-Rocha background with linear-axion momentum relaxation. Serving as a comparison channel, the dipole coupling $p_1$ is found to produce a soft asymmetric reconstruction without opening a clean hard Mott gap. Our main analysis then focuses on two axion-dependent non-minimal couplings modulated by current mixing. The $p_2$ tensor channel suppresses the zero-energy Fermi peak and shifts the dominant spectral weight to finite frequencies, resulting in a flat-bottom reconstruction. In contrast, the $p_3$ vector channel creates a strong spectral asymmetry in momentum space, generating open, Fermi-arc-like segments. Varying the momentum-relaxation strength $β/μ$ and the doping parameter $χ$ reveals a channel-dependent response to the two-current background. Increasing $β/μ$ generally broadens the $p_2$ response, whereas the one-sided $p_3$ feature varies non-monotonically under changes of the background parameters. These results clarify how current mixing, axion-induced momentum relaxation, and non-minimal fermion couplings jointly reshape holographic fermionic excitations. decision.title_zh: 带轴子动量弛豫的双流 Gubser-Rocha 模型中的费米子谱函数
decision.abstract_zh: 我们研究了在线性轴子动量弛豫的双流 Gubser-Rocha 背景中的费米子谱函数。作为对照通道，发现偶极耦合 $p_1$ 会产生一种柔和的、非对称的重构，而不会打开干净的硬 Mott 能隙。我们的主要分析随后聚焦于由电流混合调制的两个依赖于轴子的非最小耦合。$p_2$ 张量通道抑制零能费米峰，并将主导谱权重移至有限频率，形成平底重构。与之相反，$p_3$ 矢量通道在动量空间中产生强烈的谱不对称性，生成开放的、类费米弧的片段。改变动量弛豫强度 $β/μ$ 与掺杂参数 $χ$ 揭示了通道依赖的对双流背景的响应。增大 $β/μ$ 通常会拓宽 $p_2$ 响应，而单侧的 $p_3$ 特征在背景参数变化下非单调变化。这些结果阐明了电流混合、轴子诱导的动量弛豫与非最小费米子耦合如何共同重塑全息费米激发。这些结果阐明了电流混合、轴子诱导的动量弛豫与非最小费米子耦合如何共同重塑全息费米激发。
